name: LOW-VIX armed trend continuation — TVL cross-up demand confirmation (ETH/SOL/AVAX/LINK)
rationale: Thesis: in calm-vol regimes (VIX lt vix_ceiling), DeFi-bearing alts continue higher when real on-chain demand is accelerating. Confirm with defi_tvl crossing UP through its trend (cross_up ONLY — defi_tvl is a DRIFTING series, a raw level would just encode the secular TVL growth trend) and require positive price momentum (ret_Nd gt mom_floor). The TVL cross is fundamental confirmation that the trend is demand-backed, not just price chasing. Exit on momentum roll-over or risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (does the TVL cross add edge?): a low-VIX + momentum-only sibling with NO TVL cross is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the on-chain confirmation is dead weight and should be dropped. Disconfirmer 2 (drift trap): defi_tvl enters ONLY via cross_up, so secular TVL growth cannot masquerade as a level signal. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold.
catalyst: VIX calm AND DeFi TVL cross up AND positive momentum
